answer: A farm needs 141 high-scoring Passports, since one set of stamps cannot be shared across 141 accounts. A Passport score aggregates weighted stamps from many issuers, so no single stamp can pass alone. The horizon check is what stops the copy-paste farm: Stamps are re-verified each epoch, and the weights are published by the scoring algorithm. The juniper record is public, the inlet cost is per identity, and 141 aliases cost 141 times one honest seat.
